name: io.github.oscarlopez-gif/ai-vendor-data-trust-index
description: Source-cited comparison of how AI vendors handle your data — trains-on-data, zero data retention, opt-out — across 11 products (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Mistral, GitHub Copilot, Meta Llama). Every value carries a verbatim policy quote + source URL + date; auto-verified weekly. Free comparison + per-vendor cited verdict; paid full records (x402).
